::: {.lead-text}
I studied computer science at Bahria University, published a deep-learning
paper on Alzheimer's detection, and since 2024 have been building
production web, mobile and AI systems. I am now doing the Master Smart Data
Science at ENSAI to put that engineering on solid statistical ground.

- Led development of a province-scale **monitoring platform for Punjab

  rules scraping pipeline (Playwright).

  query optimisation.
- Built **United Checkout**, a Shopify app and WooCommerce plugin with MongoDB
  storage and AWS deployment.
